method: same 60 frozen paragraphs as Bergamot; plus 20-item shuffled blind A/B (blind-AB.txt, blind-key.json)

blocking_defects.tokenizer: MarianTokenizer fast-path warning is real: 'Průša' split as 'Pr, ša'; diacritics break names. source.spm exists but transformers.js used tokenizer.json.

shared_weaknesses_with_bergamot: Both fail angiosperm (血管精子/血管动物 vs should 被子植物), interpretation centers (解说->口译), convictions (定罪 vs 信念), HTML entities passed through un-decoded -> proper nouns garbled. These are general-model/domain limits, not engine-specific, and are the case for domain packs + entity preprocessing.
where_opus_was_better: aeon-15 car-less -> 无汽车者 (Bergamot said 无家可归者)
a few short NIL sentences slightly more natural (item 17)
verdict: Opus-MT en->zh (2020 Marian base, Xenova q8) is unusable as a default unsupervised reading aid: 4-5/60 paragraphs contain repetition degeneration or dropped sentences, and failures are silent (no error signal). It is also 2.5x larger on disk (120MB vs 47.6MB) and ~8-10x slower (35-60 wps CPU vs 365-530 wps). Apache-2.0 is its only advantage over Bergamot's MPL-2.0; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and compatible with shipping in a closed/AGPL desktop app as long as engine modifications are published, so this does not outweigh the quality gap.
